messages:
Tara: Ten-minute ops pulse — quick hotpath clarity check. Owners pls call out blockers for kernel / continuous-batching / KV cache before EOD. Rolling canary scheduled but we should be ready to pause. @Cheng @Alex @Priya

Cheng: PR #421 (kv-prefetch: fastpath) needs one more review, left a comment about a serialization edge-case near the end of the pipeline. @Alex can you take a look? :eyes:

Alex: On it. I reproduced a small perf regression locally (~4% p99 token latency) when seq_len > 1024. Pushed a draft fix branch and attached a tiny change to prefetch window. Snippet:```diff
- kv_prefetch_window = 128
+ kv_prefetch_window = 256
```Need to run perf harness to confirm.

Priya: I'm running eviction heuristics tests now; seeing a spike in cache churn for long sequences which might explain the OOMs. Adding a dashboard tile for churn telemetry — will share link. :mag:

Ron: Heads up — canary hit OOM on dedicated-host-3 at 13:48. Logs show repeated shard reallocation + GC pressure. Filed INF-1237 with logs. @deploy-bot can you pause canary traffic?

deploy-bot: Canary deploy "hotpath-prefetch-v3" paused by infra automation at 2026-03-18T14:02:02Z due to OOM spike. See http://infra/internal/logs/INF-1237 (automated).

Cheng: Pausing is fine. For the PR, my serialization comment is small; if Alex's perf change lands we can squash + rebase.

Alex: Thanks. I'll run the perf suite with kv_prefetch_window=256 and microbatching disabled to get a baseline. ETA ~45m.

Priya: Cross-team ask: product has a latency SLO gating for hosted customers — do we want an explicit rollback plan or a fallback model variant? If canary is paused we should pre-approve a fallback route. @Tara

Tara: Fallback variant approved: v1.2-8bit-quant. Ops: add a routing policy to prefer fallback if host p99 > 450ms for 10m, and prepare rollback playbook. I'll coordinate comms with customer success.

Ron: Ownership summary for tracking: Cheng & Alex => PR + kernel patch; Priya => telemetry + eviction tests; Tara => routing fallback + customer comms; Ron => infra ticket & sprint board. I'll add cards and ping infra to triage INF-1237.

Alex: Quick repro command for the OOMs when someone wants to run locally: `./run_canary --workers 8 --seq 2048 --memory 32G`

Priya: Dashboard tile + test run uploaded: http://dashboards/internal/prefetch-churn (internal link). Observed churn spike at seq > 1500 and sustained miss rate ~12%.

Tara: :thumbsup: Thanks — if Alex's perf run looks good we'll attempt a constrained canary (50% -> fallback routing) in ~1h. If anything else crops up, drop a note here and I'll re-open the canary control.

(brief pause, then Ron posts in thread later)

Ron: infra triage patched a kernel allocation edge-case, applied hotfix to canary hosts in staging; will re-run smoke tests and report.

Alex: Perf run complete — p99 improved to within 1% of baseline with kv_prefetch_window=256 in the disabled-microbatch config. Pushing the branch and requesting Cheng's last review.

Cheng: Reviewing now, will merge if tests pass.

Tara: Great work. Keep thread updated. I'll schedule a short postmortem if the production canary resumes and we hit any regressions.
